They would urgently contact the duty manager for an emergency written approval or sitting; if that could not be obtained before 13:30, I expect many ordinary employees would still make the low-cost date change, move the box to reserve storage, document it, and seek approval at Tuesday’s sitting.

That would knowingly create an audit/policy problem, but the irreversible loss, verified collector and booked pickup create strong pressure to hold it. A strictly rule-following employee would instead escalate and ultimately release the box for destruction if no lawful authority could be obtained; I would not, however, predict that the notes would simply be overlooked.
